sticker_success_details: You will receive your stickers in 2 to 4 weeks in a plain white envelope. Each envelope includes 3 stickers. If you need more than 3 stickers for your business, feel free to request another pack!
biz_sticker_success_hero_title: Your stickers are on their way 🎉
biz_sticker_success_hero_subtitle: You'll receive your free 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers in 2 to 4 weeks, in a plain white envelope with 3 stickers inside.
biz_sticker_success_tips_header: Good places to put your stickers
biz_sticker_success_tip_1: On your front door or window so customers see it before they walk in
biz_sticker_success_tip_2: Near your register, POS terminal, or payment area
biz_sticker_success_tip_3: On menus, price lists, or tip jars
biz_sticker_success_tip_4: Don't stick them anywhere you don't own or have permission to put them
biz_sticker_success_more_c1: If 3 stickers aren't enough for your business, feel free to request another free pack — or order in bulk from the same printer we use.
